methodology.environment: Repo .venv interpreter, parent launched with -B -X utf8, normal verifier subprocess invocation
methodology.order: Sort train query IDs lexicographically, then shuffle once with random.Random(seed). The census includes only examples returned by src.execute.parse_example. Deep-dive sample is the first 50 paired gold failures in this order.
methodology.negative_sample: Five unique uniformly sampled training doc IDs per accepted query, excluding its qrel target and any byte-identical code. Use a separate seeded generator and sorted doc IDs. Wrong means unrelated by training qrels.
methodology.classification_precedence: Classify the observed cause that first prevented a valid exact verdict. Compile errors precede any alternative output observed only after diagnostic wrapping.
